code: beta_of <- function(f) { cf <- coef(f); cf$Estimates[cf$Type == "beta"] }  ## mcglm reports the between-response correlations as a vector in the order of ## utils::combn(R, 2); rebuild the matrix so it can sit beside mc_partial_cor(). rho_matrix <- function(rho, nm) {   R <- length(nm); idx <- t(utils::combn(R, 2L))   M <- diag(R); dimnames(M) <- list(nm, nm)   M[idx] <- rho; M[idx[, 2:1]] <- rho   M }  ## mcglm() takes the Tweedie/Poisson-Tweedie power through control_initial. init_power <- function(lp, data, link, variance, power, Z,                        Ntrial = NULL, covariance = NULL, offset = NULL) {   R <- length(lp); n <- nrow(data)   if (is.null(Ntrial))     Ntrial     <- rep(list(rep(1, n)), R)   if (is.null(covariance)) covariance <- rep("identity", R)   if (is.null(offset))     offset     <- rep(list(NULL), R)   ini <- suppressMessages(mc_initial_values(     linear_pred = lp, matrix_pred = Z, link = as.list(link),     variance = as.list(variance), covariance = as.list(covariance),     offset = offset, Ntrial = Ntrial, data = data))   ini$power <- lapply(power, as.numeric)   ini }  ## Fit the same specification with both engines and time each one. fit_pair <- function(spec) {   args <- c(list(linear_pred = spec$lp, matrix_pred = spec$Z,                  data = spec$data), spec$args)   t_m <- system.time(m <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(     do.call(mcglm::mcglm, args))))[["elapsed"]]   t_g <- system.time(g <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(do.call(     mcglm_graph, c(list(between_graph = mc_between_graph("ggm")), args)   ))))[["elapsed"]]   list(name = spec$name, m = m, g = g, t_m = t_m, t_g = t_g) } pair_table <- function(p) {   g <- p$g$graph; nm <- g$response_names   idx <- t(utils::combn(g$R, 2L))   smry <- summary(p$m)$Correlation   del  <- mc_partial_cor_delta(p$g)   rho    <- as.numeric(smry[, "Estimates"])   rho_se <- as.numeric(smry[, "Std.error"])   data.frame(     pair    = paste(nm[idx[, 1]], nm[idx[, 2]], sep = "-"),     rho     = rho,     rho_p   = 2 * stats::pnorm(-abs(rho / rho_se)),     pcor    = del$pcor,     pcor_se = del$se,     pcor_p  = del$p_value,     ## how much of the marginal association survives conditioning     shrink  = 1 - abs(del$pcor) / pmax(abs(rho), 1e-8),     row.names = NULL, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) } show_matrix <- function(M, main, digits = 2) {   R <- nrow(M); lab <- rownames(M)   lim <- max(abs(M))   pal <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(64)   graphics::image(seq_len(R), seq_len(R), t(M[R:1, , drop = FALSE]),                   col = pal, zlim = c(-lim, lim), axes = FALSE,                   xlab = "", ylab = "", main = main, cex.main = .95)   graphics::axis(3, at = seq_len(R), labels = lab, tick = FALSE, las = 2,                  cex.axis = .7, line = -.8)   graphics::axis(2, at = seq_len(R), labels = rev(lab), tick = FALSE, las = 2,                  cex.axis = .7, line = -.8)   for (i in seq_len(R)) for (j in seq_len(R))     graphics::text(j, R - i + 1,                    formatC(M[i, j], format = "f", digits = digits), cex = .7)   invisible(NULL) }
